topic.title: Flood Risk / Sequential Test / Exception Test
topic.source_contract: flood sources and probability, climate-change allowance, vulnerability classification, sequential test area and alternatives, exception test, flood risk assessment, safe access, mitigation, drainage, decision and residual-risk monitoring evidence

scope_guards: Flood Zone mapping is not a site-specific flood risk assessment.
Flood Zone 1 is not proof of no flood risk from other sources.
A sequential-test submission is not a passed test.
Passing the sequential test does not automatically pass the exception test.
A flood risk assessment is not planning permission.
Planning conditions are not delivered flood mitigation.
Installed mitigation is not evidence of safe lifetime performance.
No score or promotion is written without exact tests, decision, mitigation and residual-risk evidence.
